title: Document aggregate CMake targets for GPU test sources
body: A queued build that targeted the source-named executables (cmake --build ../build/wsl --target VixenApp test_body_instance_raymarch_render test_hitrecord_readback test_selection_resolve --parallel 4) failed with Ninja unknown target. The focused tests are folded into test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_gpurender1 and test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_descriptorgatherer in VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph/tests/test_critical_nodes.cmake. Document or expose the source-to-aggregate mapping so lane briefs can build individual test coverage without a discovery retry.
